source_note: Public synthetic fixture for the F01 source-bound acting contract. No user manuscript, real person, private job, model output, or media.
source_text:
母亲问：你到底怎么了？
女儿把信压在膝上，说：我没事。
母亲看着她的手，没有立刻离开。

characters.description: Public fictional adult daughter; plain clothes; no real person.
Public fictional mother; plain clothes; no real person.

scenes.description: A plain fictional dining table with two chairs.

CH_DAUGHTER.given_circumstances: Evening at a fictional dining table; she has just read a letter that changes the family plan.

relationships.stakes: The mother may panic if she learns the letter now.

CH_DAUGHTER.objective: Keep the letter hidden until she can choose when and how to discuss it.
CH_DAUGHTER.obstacle: Her mother is watching closely and asking direct questions.
tactic_habits: Answer briefly and keep eye contact.
Move the letter out of sight below the table edge.
CH_DAUGHTER.subtext: I am fine enough for now; please do not look closer.
CH_DAUGHTER.entry_state: Seated, letter on the table, mother standing opposite.
CH_DAUGHTER.exit_state: Letter below the table edge, eye contact maintained, mother still watching.

CH_MOTHER.given_circumstances: Evening at the same fictional table; she senses her daughter is hiding something.

relationships.stakes: She fears the daughter is in trouble and will withdraw if pushed too hard.

CH_MOTHER.objective: Find out whether the daughter is actually all right.
tactic_habits: Watch the daughter's hands rather than her mouth.
CH_MOTHER.subtext: I know you are hiding something, but I am trying not to corner you.
CH_MOTHER.entry_state: Standing opposite the daughter, waiting for an answer.
CH_MOTHER.exit_state: Still standing, eyes moving to the daughter's hand, saying nothing.

source_spans.quote: 母亲看着她的手，没有立刻离开。

staging.blocking: CH_DAUGHTER is seated at the table; CH_MOTHER stands opposite, one hand resting on the chair back.
staging.gaze: They hold eye contact; the mother's gaze drops to the daughter's right hand as it moves.
spatial_constraints: The letter starts on the table and ends below the table edge.
The mother does not cross to the daughter's side.

hand_prop.action: Slide the letter off the table edge while the left hand stays open on the tabletop.
hand_prop.visible_result: The letter leaves the tabletop and disappears below the edge.

performance.motivation: Protect the mother from the letter until she can decide how to explain it.
performance.facial_microaction: A small smile arrives a beat late, then the eyes flick down and back up.
performance.body_microaction: The right hand begins to move only after the mother looks at it.
performance.ending_pose: Seated, left hand flat on the table, right hand below the edge, eyes back on the mother.

CH_DAUGHTER.trigger: The mother asks what is wrong and holds eye contact.
CH_DAUGHTER.objective: Keep the letter hidden while making the mother believe the answer is ordinary.
CH_DAUGHTER.obstacle: The mother keeps watching her hands instead of accepting the words.
CH_DAUGHTER.tactic: Answer lightly, keep eye contact, and move the letter only when the mother glances down.
CH_DAUGHTER.subtext: Do not look at the letter; if you look, she will know.
CH_DAUGHTER.reaction: Her smile is one beat late; her eyes flick to the letter and back.
CH_DAUGHTER.visible_change: Her right hand leaves the tabletop and the letter disappears below the edge.
CH_DAUGHTER.ending_state: She is still seated, eyes on the mother, right hand out of sight.

CH_MOTHER.trigger: The daughter says she is fine while her right hand starts to move.
CH_MOTHER.objective: Test whether the answer is true without driving the daughter further away.
CH_MOTHER.obstacle: The daughter's calm words and steady eye contact.
CH_MOTHER.tactic: Stay standing, keep eye contact, and watch the daughter's hands.
CH_MOTHER.subtext: I am not convinced, but I will not accuse you yet.
CH_MOTHER.reaction: Her eyes drop to the moving hand and then return to the daughter's face.
CH_MOTHER.visible_change: She notices the hand movement and chooses not to speak.
CH_MOTHER.ending_state: Still standing, watching the daughter, one hand on the chair back.

beats.visible_change: The mother asks the question; the daughter holds eye contact.
beats.performance: The daughter answers with a small, delayed smile; the mother watches her face.
beats.sound: room tone and the mother's question

beats.visible_change: The daughter says I am fine; the mother's gaze drops toward her hands.
beats.performance: The daughter keeps her left hand open on the table; the mother leans a little closer.

beats.visible_change: The letter slides below the table edge; the mother notices but does not speak.
beats.performance: The daughter moves only her right hand; the mother's eyes track it, then return to her face.
beats.camera: fixed medium two-shot, slight push in
beats.sound: paper sliding on wood, then room tone

continuity.start_state: Daughter seated; mother standing; letter on the table; both visible.
continuity.end_state: Daughter seated; mother standing; letter below the table edge in the daughter's right hand.

action_units.action: slide the letter below the table edge

shootability.fallback: If the slide is unstable, cut to a close-up of the hand and letter below the table edge.
